name: Red Ribbon
source:
After the sudden death of her lover, Sophie finds herself unable to accept her death and in her loneliness she decides to make a doll.  She constantly chases the perfection of the doll and when she's finally got the perfect one,  the doll suddenly comes to life and you decide how she navigates this. 

[From [url=https://soyemilky.itch.io/red-ribbon]itch.io[/url]]
